title: Karbal ke jaane wale
body:
Karbal ke jaane wale
karbal ke jane wale jab karbala pahuchna
mazlume karbala se mera salam kehna
kehna ke mere dil me
<<DIVIDER>>
bus itni arzu hai
maula tumhare dar par
aane ki justuju hai
tum ho imame aali aur mai hu ek sawali
<<DIVIDER>>
aka tumhare dar se
koi fira na khaali
kabse pukarta hu
dedo mujhe sahara
<<DIVIDER>>
har simt behre ghum hai
milta nahi kinara
is dehre bewafa me
beyaaro benisha hu
<<DIVIDER>>
bezaar zindagi hu
begaanae jahaan hu
armaan kuch nahi hai
bus ek dua hai lab par
<<DIVIDER>>
sab hasrate bhula kar
aankho me ashq bhar kar
faryaad kar raha hai
ek ranjo gam ka maara
<<DIVIDER>>
ehle aza hu mai bhi
ghumkhwaar hu tumhaara
apna hai kaun kisko
mai haale ghum sunaau
<<DIVIDER>>
hu mustarif kaha se
taskeene kalb laau
bechain ho raha hu
mujhko karaar dedo
<<DIVIDER>>
ashko ke waste se
ghum ki bahar dedo
gham aakhri ho mera
maidaane karbala me
<<DIVIDER>>
so jaau rote rote
gehra rahe kaza me
roze ki jaliyo se
karna dua lipatkar
<<DIVIDER>>
rakh dena thokaro me
unki mera muqaddar
jis waqt multaji ho
tu shahe do jahan se
<<DIVIDER>>
us waqt meri haajat
likh le teri zabaan se
sabke naseeb me ho
haasil teri dua ka
<<DIVIDER>>
karbobala hai markaz har sahibe aza ka
shehre musafirane
rahe khuda wahi hai
yasrab se jo gaya tha
<<DIVIDER>>
woh kafila wahi hai
jaan deke kar gae wo
nusrat shahe huda ki
kabre hai us zamin me
<<DIVIDER>>
ansare bawafa ki
karna hai pesh tujhko
har bekafan ka pursa
paamaale zulme aada ibne hasan ka pursa
<<DIVIDER>>
sahil pe alkama ke
bhai zarur jana
abbas bawafa ka
pursa wahi pe dena
<<DIVIDER>>
fir sue kabre akbar
jana bade adab se
milti thi jiski surat
shakle shahe arab se
<<DIVIDER>>
zainab ke ladlo ka
pursa zarur dena
tar apne ansuo se
asgar ki kabr karna
<<DIVIDER>>
maqtal se karbala ki
khake shifa utha ke
ek maa ko pursa dena
furde nasheb jake
<<DIVIDER>>
usdam nazar me hoga
aashur ka jo manzar
behal ranjo gam se
khudko wahi girakar
<<DIVIDER>>
khidmat me sayyada ki
zaro kataar rona
unka shareeke maatam meri taraf se hona
har pal tere safar ka
<<DIVIDER>>
ab kamyab hoga
jo kaam tu karega
kaare sawaab hoga
aakhir me dastbasta
<<DIVIDER>>
ek ilteja hai meri
ai karbala ke zaaer
jab wapsi ho teri
us waqt yaad rakhna
<<DIVIDER>>
hargiz na bhul jana
mera kafan waha se
lekar zarur aana
us din ke muntazir hai
<<DIVIDER>>
kabse kalimo meesum
karbobala pahuchkar
yeh bhi kare muharram
seene pe daste matam
<<DIVIDER>>
ashko se ankh tar ho
ehsase ghum ki had se
har saas ka guzar ho
nauha zabaan par ho
<<DIVIDER>>
mazlume karbala ka
sad hai waa shahida
sad hai waa hussainaa
